name: 硅基流动 SiliconFlow
desc: Model API serving open models on Chinese domestic chips.
desc_zh: 国产芯片上的大模型 API 服务
solves: Every model added to a product means another deployment to evaluate. One endpoint here reaches 170+ open models, running on domestic Chinese chips, billed by usage.
solves_zh: 每加一个模型就要评估一套新的部署方案。这里一个接口能调 170+ 开源模型，跑在国产芯片上，按量计费。
best_for: Open models on domestic Chinese hardware, without tuning the inference deployment.
best_for_zh: 想在国产芯片上跑开源模型，又不想自己调推理部署。
notes: The reference option when a Chinese deployment must run on Ascend-class hardware. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20260616A081NQ00
